title: Fix duplicate pet model bug, improve pet visuals, fix various gameplay issues
description: Fix the duplicate pet model bug where 2 identical models spawn for 1 equipped pet. Improve pet visuals with floating height (2-3 studs), shadow effect, and nametag. Fix various gameplay flow issues across egg hatching, upgrades, zone gates, and currency collection.
steps: Fix PetController duplicate model bug by adding initialization guard and cleanup in updateEquippedPets
Increase pet follow height to 2.5 studs above ground and add shadow Part below each pet
Ensure pets follow BEHIND the player (increase follow distance)
Verify egg hatching flow works correctly (shop button -> hatch -> receive pet)
Verify upgrade purchasing flow works correctly
Verify zone gate unlocking flow works correctly
Ensure equipped pet bar correctly displays pet data
Verify currency is correctly added after destroying destructibles
acceptance_criteria: Only exactly 1 pet model per equipped pet exists at any time
Pets float 2.5 studs above ground with a visible shadow Part beneath them
Pets follow behind the player at adequate distance (not overlapping)
Pet nametag with name visible above pet head
